summary: The beginning is a philosophical problem as well as a point in time. 道德經 calls the nameless the beginning of heaven and earth.

satellites.title: The Nameless Beginning
satellites.evidence: Daodejing 1 says 無名天地之始. The sentence stages a philosophical relation between namelessness and beginning, not a dated cosmological observation.

satellites.title: Things Have Ends and Beginnings
satellites.evidence: The Daxue: 物有本末，事有終始，知所先後，則近道矣 — things have roots and branches, affairs have ends and beginnings; know what comes first and what after, and you are near the Way.
